source: for(const id of ['#uiSupplierTools','#uiDataTools','#uiProjectDetails'])if(await n.locator(id).evaluate(e=>e.open))await n.locator(id+' > summary').click();for(const size of [[1024,768],[1366,768],[1600,900]]){await n.setViewportSize({width:size[0],height:size[1]});for(const[tab,name,target]of[['① 物料与图纸','materials','#itemBody'],['② 供应商与分配','allocation','#assignItemBody'],['③ 报价回收','quotes','#quoteRoundBody'],['④ 比价议价','comparison','#quoteTable']]){await n.getByRole('tab',{name:tab,exact:true}).click();await n.evaluate(()=>window.scrollTo(0,0));await shot('business-layout-'+size.join('x')+'-'+name,n);await n.locator(target).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await shot('business-detail-'+size.join('x')+'-'+name,n)}}await n.setViewportSize({width:1366,height:768});await n.locator('#quoteAnalysis').scrollIntoViewIfNeeded();await download('common-scope.csv',n.getByRole('button',{name:'导出本比较组全部共同项目 CSV',exact:true}),n);await saveUI();global.rich=fp('/tmp/srm-integration-data','11b-rich-layout-saved');
